title: Migrate auth to OAuth 2.1
description: Replace session cookies with OAuth 2.1 access + refresh tokens. See the auth-redesign spec for the token cache details.

title: Stream billing usage events
description: Move billing from the monthly batch job to streaming usage events aggregated per period.

title: Rebuild search index
description: Rebuild the full-text search index with the new analyzer chain and incremental refresh.

title: Auth incident hardening
description: Harden the token cache eviction policy after the May auth incident.

title: Refresh onboarding docs
description: Update the engineering onboarding guide for the new billing flow.

title: Rotate background job credentials
description: Automatic rotation of credentials for every nightly background job (index re-scan, reconciliation, digest send). Each run fetches a fresh short-lived access token per the service-to-service auth guide.

title: Harden deploy pipeline canary stage
description: Tighten the canary error-budget gate and make rollback automatic on a red canary.

title: Per-tenant rate limiter
description: Build the token bucket rate limiter with an in-memory bucket cache and an idle-bucket eviction cap.

title: On-call onboarding module
description: Add an on-call module to engineering onboarding covering paging, escalation, and the emergency patch procedure.

title: Billing reconciliation nightly run
description: Nightly reconciliation comparing streamed usage events against issued invoices, flagging drift per tenant and meter.

title: Upgrade analyzer chain
description: Ship the synonym-filter analyzer chain from the notes; no stemming, exact-term behavior preserved for ticket keys.

title: Metrics glossary refresh
description: Keep the usage metering glossary current; document the double-write rule for renamed meters.

title: Notification digest batching
description: Batch digest emails per tenant per period and move the send into the nightly window.

title: Search index cache warming
description: Warm the query cache right after the nightly re-index so the hit rate recovers within minutes instead of hours.

title: Stale feature flag cleanup
description: Remove flags older than ninety days from the deploy pipeline per the feature flag playbook.

title: Login page copy refresh
description: Update the sign-in page copy and error messages as part of the May incident follow-up.

title: Token cache LRU experiment
description: Run the LRU vs LFU eviction experiment from the tuning guide on the staging arena and pick the permanent policy.
